name: lnpl
description: Author `.lnpl` for the linkly LLM-native platform. LNPL's vocabulary is closed and absent from model training data, so a plausible-looking source compiles and then silently does nothing — an unknown verb derives no effect, and most declarations are never enforced. This plugin routes the model to the vocabulary generated from the compiler's own tables, surfaces `lnpl compile` diagnostics the moment a file is written, derives spec cases from declarations, consults the knowledge base before design decisions, and gates completion on evidence.
